description: This file is a shell script for testing the behavior of Git's file system monitoring extension (fsmonitor). It contains setup functions, various test cases, and assertions related to the fsmonitor extension, cache invalidation, index splitting, sparse checkout, and related Git features.

methods.name: clean_repo
methods.description: Resets the repository to the last commit and cleans untracked files.

methods.name: dirty_repo
methods.description: Creates modified, untracked, and new files to simulate a dirty repository.

methods.name: write_integration_script
methods.description: Writes a script for the fsmonitor test hook.
